test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 6 men and 8 women can complete as much work in a given time as 3 men and 13 women. If a man can complete a work in 12 days, then in how many days will 4 women be able to complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

6 men and 8 women can complete as much work in a given time as 3 men and 13 women

A man can complete a work in 12 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

6 men + 8 women = 3 men + 13 women

⇒ 3 men = 5 women

⇒ men/women = 5/3

So, the efficiency of men and women is 5 units and 3 units

Now, Total work = 12 × 5 = 60 units

4 women be able to complete the same work in

Required time = 60/(4 × 3) = 5

**∴ Required answer is 5 days.**
